key_insight: MineNPC-Task provides a human-derived, machine-validated benchmark and harness for evaluating memory-aware, mixed-initiative LLM agents in open-world Minecraft, closing the gap between synthetic prompts and realistic long-horizon gameplay by enforcing bounded-knowledge policies and explicit task structure.
problem_solved: Existing evaluations rely on synthetic prompts or allow out-of-world shortcuts, failing to measure an agent's memory, planning, and mixed-initiative behavior in realistic open-world settings.
method: Elicit tasks from formative and summative co-play with expert Minecraft players and normalize them into parametric templates with explicit preconditions and dependency structure.
Pair each task template with machine-checkable validators and enforce a bounded-knowledge policy that forbids out-of-world shortcuts to ensure faithful, reproducible evaluation.
Provide an evaluation harness for testing mixed-initiative, memory-aware LLM agents across these grounded, human-authored tasks in Minecraft.
impact: Enables robust, reproducible assessment of memory and planning capabilities in embodied open-world agents, guiding development of LLM agents that rely on true in-environment memory and interaction rather than dataset or prompt shortcuts.
